 Gulf Shores’ Saltiest Watering HoleWelcome to The Sloop, Matey! We’re the local pirate dive bar in Gulf Shores, AL with the best live music, all of the sports packages and top quality, homemade food. Come enjoy our famous cheesesteak on an authentic J.J. Cassone roll or stuffed in Egg Rolls! Our salads are hand chopped and the nachos are piled so high you’ll need a deck mate.Drop anchor and join us soon!

 View our daily specials on FacebookX - Not Available ToGo*We cannot accept to go orders during peak hours. This is usually from 11:30am-2:00pm during lunch and 6:30pm-8:30pm during dinner.

 

 

 
 S N A C K S

 

 

 
 SLOOP DU JOUR - 6/10please inquire about the rotating daily soup, thoughtfully prepared by the captain. don’t forget the toast points for an additional $2CHEESESTEAK EGG ROLLS X - 15choice of chicken or steak with cherry peppers, cheese whiz, and sloop slaw, hand rolled to order, fried golden brown, served with hot honey mustardWINGS - 13one pound of house brined wings, fried and tossed in buffalo, bbq, or have them naked, served with carrot sticks, celery, and choice of ranch or bleu cheeseSIZZLIN SHRIMP X - 15one dozen gulf shrimp sautéed in garlic butter, lemon, capers, grape tomatoes, red onions, and sriracha, served with toast pointsBAKED STUFFED SHROOMS - SM/LG X - 9/15philly cream cheese with sausage, stuffed in button mushrooms, baked with chablis, roasted garlic, parmesan cheese, and green onions, served with toast pointsNACHOS X - 16choice of steak, chicken or shrimp (+$2) double layered on tortillas with cheddar jack cheese, diced red onions, tomatoes, roasted poblano peppers, and queso, served with homemade guacamole, salsa and sour creamCHIPS AND SALSA - 7fried to order tortilla chips, and house made “so fresh” salsa>> add guacamole $4 / roasted poblano queso $4

 

 

 
 
 
 BOAT O’ FRIES - 5house cut - to - order kennebec potatoes - fried golden & crispy>> add chili & cheese whiz for $4BASKET O’ CHIPS - 4large order of house sliced kennebec potato chipsCHEESESTEAK PARTY FRIES - 10a double portion of hand cut fries topped with a cheesesteak>> choose from the following cheeses and included toppings: cheese whiz (our suggestion), provolone, american - xtra cheese $.75 / add for free - onions, mushrooms, bell peppers, hot cherry peppersBUFFALO PARTY FRIES - 10a double portion of house cut fries, topped with buffalo sauce, mozzarella, and choice of ranch or bleu cheeseQUESADILLA X - 14choice of grilled chicken or steak with cheddar jack cheese, diced red onions, tomatoes, and roasted poblano peppers, toasted in flour tortilla, served with sides of homemade guacamole, sour cream, and “so fresh” salsaCHEESECAKE EGG ROLLS X - 10home made cheesecake, hand rolled and flash fried, served with vanilla ice cream, strawberries & Hershey’s chocolate sauce

 

 

 
 S A L A D S

 

 

 
 HOUSE SALAD - 8/11chopped romaine, cherry tomatoes, spiraled carrots, red onions and parmesan cheeseCAESAR SALAD - SM/LG - 8/11chopped romaine lettuce, grape tomatoes, parmesan cheese, caesar dressing, and cassone croutonsDRESSING OPTIONSlemon garlic vinaigrette, balsamic vinaigrette, herbed ranch, bleu cheese

 

 

 
 ROMAINE WEDGE - SM/LG - 8/11crisp romaine lettuce topped with cherry tomatoes, spiraled carrots, red onions, bacon and bleu cheese crumblesANTIPASTO ITALIANO - 15provolone, prosciutto, capocollo, genoa salami, and pepperoni atop crispy romaine with bell peppers, mushrooms, tomatoes, and red onions - try it with lemon garlic vinaigrette 

 

 

 
 add grilled or blackened chicken $5 - grilled or blackened shrimp $6 - steak or chicken cheesesteak $6

 

 

 
 C H E E S T E A K S - H O A G I E S - S A N D W I C H E S

 

 

 
 sandwiches are proudly prepared on world famous j.j. cassone rolls in 5¾” or 11½” sizes — with a lagniappe of house sliced kennebec potato chips

 

 

 
 CHEESESTEAK - 9/17choice of premium, thinly sliced steak or chicken topped with your choice of american, provolone, or cheese whiz — add for free any of the following veggies; sautéed onions, mushrooms, bell peppers, hot cherry peppers>> make it a super yacht with blackened shrimp, and queso for $4 small / large $6ITALIANO - 9/17prosciutto, capocollo, genoa salami, pepperoni, provolone dressed with tomatoes, romaine lettuce, red onions, evoo, balsamic and a house blend of italian seasonings>> add sweet peppers, hot peppers, or green olives for $.75 eachHOTWING HOAGIE - 9/17chicken cheesesteak with buffalo sauce, mozzarella cheese, hot cherry peppers, lettuce and tomatoes dressed with your choice of ranch or bleu cheeseSPICY SAUSAGE AND PEPPERS - 9/17spicy italian sausage with bell peppers, sautéed onions, provolone cheese, house marinara, italian seasonings, and parmesanSAUCY MEATBALL - 9/17beef and porkblend meatballs in our house marinara topped with melted provolone, italian seasonings, and parmesanTWIN CHEESEBURGER - 14two 4oz. certified angus beef patties grilled to order on a brioche bun - dressed with lettuce, tomatoes, red onions, pickles, and your choice of cheese - white american, provolone, cheese whiz, mozzarella, cheddar jack>> top your burger with a cheesesteak, however you like it for $6CHICKEN SANDWICH - 13choice of grilled or blackened chicken breast on a brioche bun with lettuce, tomatoes, red onions, pickles, and choice of cheese - white american, provolone, cheese whiz, mozzarella, cheddar jackSLOOP DOG - 15grilled foot long nathan’s all beef hot dog topped with ol’ fashioned chili, cheddar jack, cheese whiz, and diced red onions

 

 

 
 ADD - ONS$3 - bacon, capocollo, salami, pepperoni, prosciutto, guacamole, fried egg / $.75 extra cheese(s), lettuce, tomato, jalapeno, sauces

 

 

 
 F O R T H E K I D S 

 

 

 
 served with house cut-to-order fries

 

 

 
 GRILLED CHEESE - 7melty american, provolone, cheddar jack and mozzarella cheeses on toasted j.j. cassone rollBURGER - 10one 4oz certified angus beef patty grilled to order with american cheese on brioche bunCHIKCEN FINGERS - 10breaded fried chicken breast tenders with choice of ranch, bbq, buffalo

 

 

 
 *CONSUMING RAW OR UDNERCOOKED MEATS, POULTRY, SEAFOOD SHELLFISH, OR EGGS MAY INCREASE THE RISK OF CERTAIN FOODBORNE ILLNESS.

 Located in Beautiful Gulf Shores, Alabama!The Sloop Galley and Spirits began as an idea from two local restauranteurs with over 40 years of restaurant experience. The location and timing came together in the summer of 2019. The Sloop prides itself on fresh quality foods made in house and exceptional service. One of the partners, James Gallen, from the Philadelphia area decided to incorporate original Philly cheesesteaks on the menus as they are not offered in the south. The other partner, BR Mock, decorated the establishment with authentic sailing tools, pictures, and memorabilia from his days sailing.The Sloop is a locals eatery and watering hole. We do welcome families and children but please remember that we are a sports bar with great homemade items. We do enjoy our island visitors as well! Due to our size limitation we can only handle seating of 8 or less during peak hours.Unfortunately we cannot accept to go orders during peak hours. This is usually from 11:30am-2:00pm during lunch and 6:30pm-8:30pm during dinner. Due to our size and staff limitations our to go menu is limited. Thank you for understanding.
